Infobox for raid pages, built on [[Module:Infobox]] (DRUID). Every parameter is optional; empty rows are hidden. Labels are translated automatically from [[Module:Labels/data]]. Without <code>image</code> it shows <code>File:&lt;page name&gt;.png</code> when that file exists, or the placeholder otherwise, so uploading <code>File:&lt;page name&gt;.png</code> is enough to replace it.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Infobox Raid
|title=
|image=
|caption=
|quote=
|Raid id=
|Dimension=
|Raid site=
|Waves=
|Bosses=
|Scout health=
|Scout melee=
|Scout ki=
|Rewards=
|Defeat penalty=
}}
</pre>
